kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ (ṣallā llāhu ʕalayhi wasallama, “may God bless him and grant him peace”). The proper noun is re-vocalized from the initialism.
g: PBUH (“peace be upon him”, following mention of the prophet Muhammad).

kaikki_vikisozluk.t: From صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّٰهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ (ṣallā llāhu ʕalayhi wasallama, “may God bless him and grant him peace”). The proper noun is re-vocalized from the initialism.
g: Mahomet (a derogatory term for the prophet of Islam)
